title: Warden Boss Bar
description: A datapack that adds a boss bar for the Warden and a new advancement for killing it.
body:
_This is my first datapack I published on Modrinth._ So I wanted to make a boss bar for the Warden entity because it literally has like 500 HP. This datapack works on 1.20.5 or later.

This datapack includes:
- **Warden Boss Bar**
- A new advancement called **Should've Been the Final Boss**

_Go and Check the gallery to see everything this Datapack adds!_
